::: {.front-intro}
Each study takes one question about the boat and answers it with OpenFOAM simulations: what was
computed, what it shows, and how sure the answer is. The simulation setup, the study files and a dated
log of findings for each study are in [the repository](https://github.com/kmamykin/iom_cfd).
:::
